chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā al-Yaqṭīnī, from ʿAlī ibn Mahzīyār, from Abī al-Ḥusayn, who said:
I wrote to Abī al-Ḥasan al-Thālith عليه السلام:
I have endowed a piece of land for my children, for hajj, and for charitable causes, and you have a right in it after me, and for those after you; but I have removed it from that course.
So he said: “You are absolved, and it has been made expansive for you.”

key_terms.أَرْضًا: a piece of land or property
key_terms.أَزَلْتُهَا: I removed it or revoked it
key_terms.وَقَفْتُ: I endowed or dedicated as a waqf

ai.seo_question: Can a person revoke or alter an endowment that included a right for the Imam عليه السلام and charitable purposes?
ai.summary: This hadith concerns a legal question about an endowed property that had been assigned to one's children, hajj, charitable causes, and a right connected to the Imam عليه السلام and those after him. The Imam عليه السلام replies by releasing the questioner from liability and granting him latitude, indicating permissibility in altering that arrangement in this case.
